messages:
Maria (CSM): Heads up — Turnstile (acct: acmeturn) onboarding hit a big cost bump. Embedding calls up ~4x in last 24h, QBR with them next Tue. Can we triage before the deck? :eyes:
Eli (FinOps): Yikes. Do we have the breakdown by route/model? Rough daily token delta?
Sam (SWE): I pulled logs — looks like a migration job that re-ingested old docs triggered duplicate prefix requests. Possible SDK retry issue (sdk v0.9.1).
deploy-bot: Alert: high-embedding-cost detected for acmeturn — 2026-03-18T09:12:08Z — delta +312k tokens.
Maria (CSM): Here's quick query I ran in console to get per-route spend:
```
SELECT route, SUM(tokens) as tokens
FROM usage
WHERE account_id = 'acmeturn' AND ts >= now() - interval '48 hours'
GROUP BY route
ORDER BY tokens DESC
```
Top route is `/embed/bulk` (73%).
Jordan (CS Ops): Can we apply a soft throttle or short-term quota on `/embed/bulk` for their dev org? Prefer non-disruptive but prevents runaway spend.
Sam (SWE): Yes — we can add a temporary rate-limit policy on that route for their org id. I'll push a rule: max 500 reqs/min for next 72h and monitor.
Eli (FinOps): Also recommend a retroactive credit & short cost remediation plan in the QBR. Need numbers for renewal risk. If spend spike eats >30% of their remaining credit, flag renewal as at-risk.
Maria (CSM): Agreed. I'll put a slide showing cost delta, root cause (migration re-ingest), and mitigation steps. I also want an enablement session for their engineers to avoid replays. Jordan, can ops run the session with them?
Jordan (CS Ops): Yes — 30m triage + 45m best-practices workshop. I'll coordinate times. I'll also capture feedback items in our onboarding playbook.
Sam (SWE): FYI small config snippet to avoid duplicate re-ingest (send once, idempotency key):
```
client.embed_bulk(docs, idempotency_key=job_id)
```
Recommend we add this snippet to the developer onboarding checklist.
Eli (FinOps): For the QBR numbers I need: last-month baseline tokens, current 7-day avg, projected 30-day if current trend continues. Maria, can you share baseline?
Maria (CSM): Baseline was ~120k tokens/day for embeddings. Current 7-day avg 350k. Projected 30-day = ~10.5M if unchanged. I'll attach those to the QBR deck.
Jordan (CS Ops): Action items:
- Sam: deploy temp throttle rule `/embed/bulk` for acmeturn (ETA 30m)
- Maria: add cost delta + remediation slide to QBR (ETA today EOD)
- Eli: draft credit remediation + renewal risk note (ETA tomorrow)
- Jordan: schedule enablement workshop and update onboarding playbook (ETA 48h)
Sam (SWE): Working on throttle now, will post confirmation + metric link when live.
deploy-bot: Policy updated: rate limit rule applied to org acmeturn for route `/embed/bulk` — active 2026-03-18T09:47:15Z.
Maria (CSM): Thanks team. I'll also capture the customer's feedback about the confusing migration docs and add two quick fixes to the docs repo. Adding :thumbsup: to the QBR slide to call out "cost root cause & fix" so Sales has context.
Eli (FinOps): Once Sam posts the live metrics, I'll run the projected savings calc and publish a short note to the renewal playbook.
Jordan (CS Ops): Leaving this thread open until after the workshop and the QBR prep. If anything else spikes ping here.
Maria (CSM): Copy — will update thread with deck link and postmortem notes after the workshop.
